setup.text: First, locate the ledger seam at the pinned library version.

traced-build-traced-build-traced-validat.text: Prove the correspondence check can fail, add the traced build and the check, carry it to the runner, and add its CI step.

capture-replay-capture-and-replay-captur.text: Table tests for every class first, then the pure module, capture, arguments, parameters and evaluation. The first devnet run checks the premise; then the rows run with capture on, and the discovered refusals are classified against Lean, with a committed table for those the model was not asked about.

capture-replay-repairs-epic-209-operator.text: Four repairs from live evidence. The first attempt at the unknown-key proof missed the path the story takes and is superseded. The phase-one reject now declares a budget it can finish within. The witness script gets its own replay route, the causes split into no route, a differing hash and an unidentified script, and the captured serialization refusal is replayed offline beside its original. The unknown-key proof is repaired on the executed path and shown live.

comparison-receipt-controls-ci-done-rele.text: Compare reasons at the places that decide and throw today, writing evidence first; fill attribution branches, add the ruled receipt fields, the wrong-reason and accepting controls, and the CI assertions, each seen red then green, including a relabelled driver refusal and an unlisted one. The present-key insert row now runs as a story through the same interpreter, so Lean is asked about it. The serialization refusal gets an offline compiler diagnostic for the scripts that print nothing, kept apart from reasons. Each dedicated CI step also publishes its receipts path before the row runs, so a failing row keeps both its failure and its evidence, proved by running the real step with a failing row.

book-book-book-states-observation-limits.text: The book run now also executes and renders the occupied-key story, so its refusal appears with its reason. Restate the limit through the generator, regenerate the book, update its usage test, and prepare the documentation follow-up for the epic without editing outside the fence.

final-delivery-narrowed-acceptance-2026-.text: Join main without rewriting the branch, moving the replay capture behind the module that opens the node, and rebind the build correspondence to the repaired validators. Compare a refused batch on its reason, judging a reject batch on the refunds it pays. Give the fold batch a tamper that mints both tokens at the first key, and run it in the registration chapter. Compare the empty fold, the crossed refunds and the two short-reject controls through the batch questions. Put the early-rejection row under the replay and extent checks. Publish the stale-root fold, the surplus actions and the wrong constructor as unmet, with their issues. Last, regenerate the book from a run at the joined head and restamp these pages.

rulings-of-2026-10-02-on-the-escalations.text: Two rulings close the escalations. The refund-position divergence is recorded now and fixed later: the phase-one reject row submits a reject paying its owner short at the refund's place and the rest elsewhere at the owner's key, and records the chain refusing and the model accepting, never as a pass. And the stale-root fold, the surplus actions and the wrong constructor carry the verdict unmet by ruling, each naming its issue, in the debt report beside the phase-one reject.
